items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 30:1
items.html: (To the question) When she receives in the manner of the degree, namely from ZA, she is in her own house, for then the Mochin emerge upon her MAN, which is from the aspect of Malchut. But in the Mochin of the separation, which she receives from the upper Aba and Ima, who are the upper one of ZA, there it is discerned as the permission of the groom. Also, the MAN of these Mochin are the aspect of male MAN, from the aspect of the Yesod of Malchut, which is the aspect of Benjamin included in Joseph, and not the aspect of the MAN of Malchut that are particular to herself. And for these two reasons, these Mochin that she receives are discerned as from the permission of the groom, and not from the aspect of her own house.
